evals.prompt: Add an assignee picker to each task row. The repo uses shadcn/ui on Base UI; components/ui has Popover, InputGroup, Avatar, Button, and Item, but no combobox. Five feature files already hand-build a search popover from Popover and InputGroup.
assertions: Runs the ui_inventory.py inventory (or reads components/ui by hand and says so) before writing any component
Checks the registry for a combobox before creating one
Treats the five existing search popovers as a missing primitive and puts one picker in components/ui rather than a sixth copy
Imports every part from @/components/ui/*, with no @base-ui/react import in feature code
Reports each part as Reused, Extended, Composed, or Created, with a reason for anything Created

evals.prompt: Make the Archive button on the project header red and a bit smaller than the other buttons.
assertions: Uses an existing Button variant and size (such as destructive and sm) or adds one in components/ui/button.tsx
Adds no color, padding, height, or radius classes to the Button at the call site
Renders no raw <button> element
Runs the audit on the changed files or states that it could not

evals.prompt: Add a view toggle (list or board) to the projects toolbar. components.json says the style is radix-nova with lucide icons, but the ui/ files import @base-ui/react and the app imports icons from HugeIcons.
assertions: Reads the stack from the imports and says components.json is stale
Uses Base UI composition (the render prop) rather than asChild
Uses HugeIcons for the icons, not lucide
Uses the existing ui/ toggle group wrapper, or extends it, instead of importing Base UI's ToggleGroup in the page

evals.prompt: We need a Gantt-style timeline of tasks by week. Nothing in components/ui or the shadcn registry draws one. Build it.
assertions: Builds the component rather than refusing or forcing an unsuitable existing one
States what was searched, the nearest existing component, and why it fails
Writes a contract covering props, states, keyboard and focus behavior, and data ownership
Builds its controls and surfaces from components/ui parts (for example Button, Tooltip, and Card) instead of raw elements

evals.prompt: Spec a ProjectStatusBadge component with active, paused, blocked, and completed states before we build it.
assertions: Checks for an existing Badge and composes or extends it instead of defining a new primitive
Keeps the mapping from project status to label and tone in the projects feature, not in the Badge primitive
Covers accessibility: text carries the meaning, and the label does not truncate
Labels sizes or behaviors the repo does not show as proposals
